inconsistency_note: The paper states 'frequency of kdr mutation (0.99) (49/50)'. It is not explicitly stated whether 49/50 represents carriers (which would give a carrier frequency of 0.98) or if there were 49 RR homozygotes and 1 RS heterozygote ((49*2 + 1)/100 = 0.99 allele frequency).
source_text: Molecular analysis of the wild Anopheles population from Dangbo showed very high frequency of kdr mutation (0.99) (49/50).
